CREATE function CDN.SrtStanMetoda(@Srt_GIDNumer int, @Tor smallint = 0, @Rodzaj smallint = 0, @DataNaDzienC int = null, @DataDok int = null, @ZestTryb tinyint = 0) returns smallint AS BEGIN
declare @OT smallint declare @ZMT smallint declare @ZPA smallint declare @ZPK smallint
set @OT = 2048 set @ZMT = 2548 set @ZPA = 2050 set @ZPK = 2051
declare @ZestTrybSrodek tinyint = 0 declare @ZestTrybZestaw tinyint = 1 declare @ZestTrybElement tinyint = 2
declare @ZestOdlaczenie tinyint = 1 declare @ZestPrzylaczenie tinyint = 2
if (@ZestTryb not in (@ZestTrybElement, @ZestTrybZestaw) ) set @ZestTryb = @ZestTrybSrodek
declare @_rv smallint
if @Tor = 0 begin if @ZestTryb = @ZestTrybSrodek begin select @_rv = case @Rodzaj when 0 then --metoda Metoda
end from (select
case when pOT.she_gidtyp is null then
Srodek.Srt_MetodaUm
else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null and oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then pOT.She_MetodaUm else case when oZMT2.SHE_GIDTyp IS null then oZMT1.She_MetodaUm else oZMT2.She_MetodaUm end end end as Metoda
from cdn.SrtKarty Srodek left join cdn.SrtZestElem on Srodek.Srt_GIDNumer = SZE_SrtNumer and ( (@DataNaDzienC is null and SZE_DataOdlaczenia = 0) or (@DataNaDzienC is not null and SZE_DataPrzylaczenia <= @DataNaDzienC and (SZE_DataOdlaczenia = 0 or SZE_DataOdlaczenia >= @DataNaDzienC)) ) left join cdn.SrtKarty Zestaw on SZE_SrtZestNumer = Zestaw.Srt_GIDNumer
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E1.SHE_Data = (select min(E2.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E2 where E2.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E2.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E2.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E2.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select min(E3.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where E3.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E3.SHE_Data = (select min(E4.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT)) ) as pOT on Srodek.srt_gidnumer = pOT.She_SrtNumer
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 1 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 1 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 1 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZMT1 on Srodek.srt_gidnumer = oZMT1.She_SrtNumer
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 1 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 1 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 1 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZMT2 on Srodek.srt_gidnumer = oZMT2.She_SrtNumer
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZPA on Srodek.srt_gidnumer = oZPA.She_SrtNumer
where Srodek.Srt_GIDNumer = @Srt_GIDNumer and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and Srodek.Srt_Data <= @DataDok) ) as a1 end
else if @ZestTryb = @ZestTrybElement begin select @_rv = case @Rodzaj when 0 then --metoda Metoda
end from (select Srt_GIDNumer, case when pOT.she_gidtyp is null and oZPA.SHE_GIDTyp IS null then Srt_MetodaUm else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null and oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then case when oZMT1.SHE_GIDTyp IS not null then oZPA.SHE_MetodaUm else pOT.She_MetodaUm end else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT1.She_MetodaUm when oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT2.She_MetodaUm else case when cdn.DateDiffClarion(2, oZMT1.she_Data, oZMT2.she_Data) <= 0 then oZMT2.She_MetodaUm else oZMT1.She_MetodaUm end end end end as Metoda from cdn.SrtZestElem left join cdn.SrtKarty on Srt_GIDNumer = SZE_SrtZestNumer left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E1.SHE_Data = (select min(E2.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E2 where --E2.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E2.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E2.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E2.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E2.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT) and E1.SHE_SZELp = (select min(E3.SHE_SZELp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where --E3.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E3.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E3.SHE_Data = (select min(E4.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where --E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E4.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT)) ) as pOT on --srt_gidnumer = pOT.She_SrtNumer SZE_ID = pOT.SHE_SZEId
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 1 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where --SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 1 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SZELp = (select max(E4.SHE_SZELp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where --E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E4.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 1 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where --E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E5.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZMT1 on --srt_gidnumer = oZMT1.She_SrtNumer SZE_ID = oZMT1.SHE_SZEId
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 1 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where --SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 1 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SZELp = (select max(E4.SHE_SZELp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where --E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E4.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 1 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where --E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E5.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObow = 2 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZMT2 --on srt_gidnumer = oZMT2.She_SrtNumer on SZE_ID = oZMT2.SHE_SZEId
left outer join ( select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and E1.SHE_PrzesStrona = 2 and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where --SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK) ) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SZELp = (select max(E4.SHE_SZELp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where --E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E4.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where --E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer E5.SHE_SZEId = E1.SHE_SZEId and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp in (@ZPA, @ZPK)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok))) ) as oZPA on --srt_gidnumer = oZW2.She_SrtNumer SZE_ID = oZPA.SHE_SZEId
where --Srt_GIDNumer = @Srt_GIDNumer SZE_ID = @Srt_GIDNumer and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and SZE_DataPrzylaczenia <= @DataDok) ) as a1 end
else if @ZestTryb = @ZestTrybZestaw begin select @_rv = case @Rodzaj when 0 then --metoda Metoda
end from (select Srt_GIDNumer, case when pOT.she_gidtyp is null then Srt_MetodaUm else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null and oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then pOT.She_MetodaUm else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT1.She_MetodaUm when oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT2.She_MetodaUm else case when cdn.DateDiffClarion(2, oZMT1.she_Data, oZMT2.she_Data) <= 0 then oZMT2.She_MetodaUm else oZMT1.She_MetodaUm end end end end as Metoda from cdn.SrtKarty left outer join (select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E1.SHE_Data = (select min(E2.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E2 where E2.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E2.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E2.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E2.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select min(E3.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where E3.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E3.SHE_Data = (select min(E4.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT))) as pOT on srt_gidnumer = pOT.She_SrtNumer
left outer join (select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 1 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 1 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 1 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObow = 1 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)))) as oZMT1 on srt_gidnumer = oZMT1.She_SrtNumer

end from (select Srt_GIDNumer, case when pOT.she_gidtyp is null then Srt_MetodaAm else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null and oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then pOT.She_MetodaAm else case when oZMT2.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT1.She_MetodaAm when oZMT1.she_Gidtyp is null then oZMT2.She_MetodaAm else case when cdn.DateDiffClarion(2, oZMT1.she_Data, oZMT2.she_Data) <= 0 then oZMT2.She_MetodaAm else oZMT1.She_MetodaAm end end end end as Metoda from cdn.SrtKarty left outer join (select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E1.SHE_Data = (select min(E2.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E2 where E2.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E2.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E2.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E2.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select min(E3.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where E3.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E3.SHE_Data = (select min(E4.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @OT))) as pOT on srt_gidnumer = pOT.She_SrtNumer
left outer join (select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObowAm = 1 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 2 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObowAm = 1 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 2 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObowAm = 1 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 2 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObowAm = 1 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 2 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)))) as oZMT1 on srt_gidnumer = oZMT1.She_SrtNumer
left outer join (select E1.* from cdn.SrtHistElem as E1 where (E1.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E1.SHE_MsObowAm = 2 and (E1.SHE_Tor = 2 or E1.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E1.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E1.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and E1.SHE_Data = (select max(E3.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E3 where SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E3.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E3.SHE_MsObowAm = 2 and (E3.SHE_Tor = 2 or E3.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E3.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E3.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)) and E1.SHE_SrtLp = (select max(E4.SHE_SrtLp) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E4 where E4.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E4.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E4.SHE_MsObowAm = 2 and (E4.SHE_Tor = 2 or E4.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E4.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E4.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok) and E4.SHE_Data = (select max(E5.SHE_Data) from cdn.SrtHistElem as E5 where E5.SHE_SrtNumer = E1.She_SrtNumer and (E5.SHE_GIDTyp = @ZMT and E5.SHE_MsObowAm = 2 and (E5.SHE_Tor = 1 or E5.SHE_Tor = 0)) and (@DataNaDzienC is null or ( not @DataNaDzienC is null and E5.SHE_Data <= @DataNaDzienC)) and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and E5.SHE_DataZap <= @DataDok)))) as oZMT2 on srt_gidnumer = oZMT2.She_SrtNumer where Srt_GIDNumer = @Srt_GIDNumer and (@DataDok is null or not @DataDok is null and Srt_Data <= @DataDok) ) as a1 end end
return(@_rv)
